audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called this HARD 8/10 with Vex winning all seven rows. The content layer and packet.levelChart both give Katarina all seven, and the win rate is 50.34% over 2819 games.
audit.why: Vex's anti-dive is singular — Doom 'n Gloom eats exactly one dash and then has to recharge — so a Katarina who spends a junk Shunpo on a wave dagger gets a free window every cycle. That is an even lane decided by passive tracking, not a hard counter.
audit.corrected: All seven sides to Katarina with rewritten whys, diff HARD to EVEN, tone to the EVEN amber, diffRating 8/10 to 5/10, carryRating 8.5/10 to 6/10.

audit.why: Level 3 is the first real kill window once Doom is baitable; level 6 Death Lotus (75/60/45s) beats Shadow Surge (140/120/100s) in a straight 1v1 with Doom down; first item adds kill pressure to an immobile mage; late her one fear per cycle cannot stop repeated resets.
audit.corrected: Ratings set at a slight Katarina edge across the board rather than a Vex sweep.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits, and the page never stated that Doom 'n Gloom cancels Death Lotus even though that is the single most punishing interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Doom 'n Gloom is flagged hardCC and explicitly interrupts dashes; Death Lotus is flagged channel, so a fear landing mid-spin ends the ultimate. Personal Space is 16/15/14/13/12s at only 475 range; Looming Darkness is a flat 12s. Shadow Surge is a projectile, so it can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with the real numbers plus the one-dash rule; the fear-cancels-Lotus interaction written into dontsFull[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Twelve misgendering findings (Vex called he/his), two copy-paste bleeds, a cooldowns field with no digit, and a 'fifteen-second invitation' that matches no cooldown in her kit.
audit.why: Lint computed the first fourteen deterministically; champ-gender.js lists vex as female. The fifteen-second figure is a magnitude with no source.

notes: Another inverted page: HARD 8/10 with all seven rows to Vex against a 50.34% win rate, an all-Katarina packet chart and a content layer arguing Katarina wins every stage. Set to EVEN 5/10 with the chart aligned. Six report entries were edited rather than the usual cap of two — five of them are single-word pronoun swaps that lint flagged (Vex is female), and the sixth is the final rating line that would otherwise contradict the corrected difficulty. None of them is a generalising rewrite. Removed the 'fifteen-second invitation' magnitude: nothing in Vex's kit has a fifteen-second cooldown, and Doom 'n Gloom's recharge is not a number Riot's text gives. The '8-10 seconds' recharge and '575-range' figures in the content layer are likewise unsourced — listed in unverified, and I did not repeat them. suspectNames flagged 'Her Shadow Surge' in content.mid; that is the correct Riot name with a possessive in front and is a false positive.
